entities.summary: Reuben Eugene Bjorkman is an American former head coach of the University of North Dakota Fighting Sioux hockey men's team. A graduate of Roseau, Minnesota High School, where he led his team to a state championship in 1946, Bjorkman was a member of the US Olympic teams in 1948 and 1952. He was a three-year letter winner at the University of Minnesota.
